review_facts.paraphrase: A buyer said their title deed was ready as promised

variants.message:
Hi Savanna Plots team 👋 Your website is solid: it loads fast on mobile and looks current. But it doesn't link to any social pages, which is where a lot of plot buyers scroll before they call. I mocked up a few posts in your colours. Have a look. Should I send you the full set?
— Swalleh, Raswal Tech Solutions

Habari Savanna Plots. A buyer said their title deed was ready as promised, which is exactly the kind of story that works well in posts, yet your website doesn't link to any social pages. I mocked up a few posts in your colours. Have a look. Want me to send the full preview? Asante!
— Swalleh, Raswal Tech Solutions
